title: Turkish-Style Masarepa Flatbread
description: A traditional Mexican-inspired flatbread made with masarepa, perfect as a side dish or snack.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine masarepa and water.
2. Add olive oil, salt, and yeast to the mixture. Mix until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until smooth.
4. Divide the dough into 2-3 equal portions, depending on desired flatbread size.
5. Roll out each portion into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
7. Place the flatbreads on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the flatbreads are lightly browned and crispy.
9. Remove from oven and sprinkle with chopped cilantro, if desired.
